comments: Replace with any overall comment. Five of the six ambiguities are already resolved in requirements/normalized/ETA-411.json from the answers given on 2026-09-01; approving this artifact confirms those resolutions as well as the criteria. AMB-ETA-411-006 remains open and asks whether the menu link labelled 'Organization' counts as a header route to Preferences. It can be answered here, or deferred without blocking the other criteria.

itemDecisions.comment: An organization user who signs in reaches the Home page. Depends on AMB-ETA-411-003.
Home page offers three activatable dashboard tiles: New Transaction, Workspace, Preferences. Observed, not stated in Jira. AMB-ETA-411-001 and AMB-ETA-411-003 resolved.
New Transaction tile leads to the New Transaction page. Proven by landing URL per the AMB-ETA-411-002 resolution.
Workspace tile leads to the Workspace page. Proven by landing URL only; this destination has no unique on-screen element.
Preferences tile leads to the Preferences page. Proven by landing URL only; this destination has no unique on-screen element.
Command Center control in the upper left corner returns the user Home. AMB-ETA-411-005 resolved: accepted as-is, automated via the #bannerBackground id selector, not filed as an accessibility defect.
NEW. Header navigation offers New Transaction and Workspace links duplicating the tiles. Note this is TWO duplicates, not three: there is no header Preferences link. See AMB-ETA-411-006.

NEW. Header New Transaction link leads to the New Transaction page. Destination taken from the link href; this link was never activated during reconnaissance and must be confirmed during PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION.
NEW. Header Workspace link leads to the Workspace page. Destination taken from the link href; never activated during reconnaissance, so it must be confirmed during PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION.
